stages.name: accept

# draft budget  (S0=93.3 ms -> 10.72 t/s; step(T=4)=247.98 ms)
cost(T) = 41.74 + 51.56*T  ms      [2-point fit: describes, does not test]
  per-token term    : 51.56 ms   (kernel 8.36 = 16.2%; everything else 43.20 = 83.8%)

## the same-harness ratio, inverted (no cross-harness error)
  measured ON/OFF = 0.889 at k=3 => per-draft accept alpha = 0.654
  break-even alpha at k=3 is 0.731 => that k is a NET LOSS today
  at alpha=0.654 the best k is 1: 11.42 t/s = 1.066x the MTP-off baseline
    k=1:  11.42 t/s   1.066x   <- best
    k=2:  10.60 t/s   0.989x
    k=3:   9.53 t/s   0.889x
